answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x during peak settlement writes; the objective forbids losing those writes. Rollback is unavailable (compliance lock on the security patch) even though memory_b1 and the 2h release timing make a bad build plausible. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail requests and would shed customer writes. Read-replica routing (memory_b5) recovered write latency only by offloading report/dashboard reads, which is not the load described here. Regional failover is not evidenced as a zonal fault and is risky mid-peak. memory_b3 is the closest match (headroom absorbing a write surge) so that is the single intervention; verifying b3 because the archived case was pre-peak provisioning and may not transfer to adding capacity after latency has already climbed. Uncertainty remains that a release regression would not be cured by capacity.
